purpose: AI lower_return and frontal_trunk_hold supervised score evidence
source_role_policy: existing source roles immutable; new sources assigned before model selection

requirements.independent_final_test: separate new people/source sessions reserved unopened; existing exposed diagnostic test remains separate

notes: Counts are a proposed minimum intake, not achieved data or accuracy guarantee.
No grade0 induced or claimed. Observed1/2 only until real reviewed0 evidence exists.
No person-wide normal/error labels. Individual completed cycles reviewed from video, initial-ready separate from movement severity.
Record explicit video plus joints with user ready/start permission; current joint-only7 repetitions have no quality labels.
Same-person/group/synchronized views kept together; never randomly split adjacent cycles.
Partial return requires observed top, actual lower turnaround and later same-cycle context; clipping/occlusion/user stop remains unknown.
Frontal trunk target is left/right trunk stability; sagittal arch/forward bend and arm asymmetry are separate.
No forced severe errors/weights for capture. A demonstrable mild unloaded variation is only a recording condition; label remains unknown until review.
Camera and app operations owned by integration thread.
